caveats: The Q4 value is derived, not reported directly. It is full-year operating income (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) minus the nine-month year-to-date figure (to 2026-03-31).

claims.text: P&G's operating income for fiscal Q4 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026) was $3.95 billion. This is a derived value: FY2026 operating income of $19.748 billion minus the nine-month figure of $15.798 billion.
